notes.title: New Demo Version (08/09)
notes.content: [h1]New Things[/h1][p]The Crow: Now when you start taking too long a crow will spawn trying to guide you to the exit. You can kill it, disabling this forever.[/p][p]New Starting screen: Now you can choose the language from the start.[/p][p]Ectoplasm: Now souls can spawn ectoplasm puddles when idle, these have 2 different variants, Aetherium and Necroplasm, both can be used to purify/corrupt souls, you can also combine them to make holy water, unholy water and stale water, that can also be given to souls.[/p][p]You can combine Aetherium with Rocks to make Red Crystals[/p][p]Souls will gain affection when fed.[/p][p]Souls will drop ectoplasm depending on their power (hidden stat, drops more with more power, can be increased by feeding mainly stale water) and purity, pure souls give more Aetherium, impure souls give more Necroplasm.[/p][p]Added a few new soul accessories, eyeliners, blush, runes and new horns.[/p][p]Added a new level decoration.[/p][p]Added a new condition, INSANE, obviously from low sanity.[/p][p][/p][h2]The Purest Soul[/h2][p]You may find the purest soul around sometimes, it's not like the other souls.[/p][p]It'll follow you around and act as a shortcut to send pure souls to heaven, since getting to the limbo is so hard.[/p][p]I'll keep adding new interactions to this NPC on next versions.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bugs and balancing[/h2][p]Crafting linked brain no longer dupes a ritual candle.[/p][p]The game should no longer crash on entering purgatory.[/p][p](these were from a hotfix earlier this week.)[/p][p]The walkie talkie should now translate correctly.[/p][p]Pumpkins are now considered bait.[/p][p]Red candles are now much more viable, their increased light decay is much smaller.[/p][p]The exit's tooltip should appear on a higher layer.[/p][p][/p][p]Anyways, I have plans for a bigger update, not sure if it'll be for next week, but it's coming eventually.[/p][p]"BURN THE WITCH"[/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: The Crow: Now when you start taking too long a crow will spawn trying to guide you to the exit. You can kill it, disabling this forever.
New Starting screen: Now you can choose the language from the start.

Ectoplasm: Now souls can spawn ectoplasm puddles when idle, these have 2 different variants, Aetherium and Necroplasm, both can be used to purify/corrupt souls, you can also combine them to make holy water, unholy water and stale water, that can also be given to souls.
You can combine Aetherium with Rocks to make Red Crystals
Souls will gain affection when fed.

Souls will drop ectoplasm depending on their power (hidden stat, drops more with more power, can be increased by feeding mainly stale water) and purity, pure souls give more Aetherium, impure souls give more Necroplasm.
Added a few new soul accessories, eyeliners, blush, runes and new horns.
Added a new level decoration.
Added a new condition, INSANE, obviously from low sanity.
It'll follow you around and act as a shortcut to send pure souls to heaven, since getting to the limbo is so hard.

tags.bug: Crafting linked brain no longer dupes a ritual candle.
The game should no longer crash on entering purgatory.
The walkie talkie should now translate correctly.

tags.balance_change: Red candles are now much more viable, their increased light decay is much smaller.

tags.bug: The exit's tooltip should appear on a higher layer.

notes.title: New Demo Version (29/08)
notes.content: [h1]The Game is Mostly Complete![/h1][p]Yet, it's not.[/p][p]I basically have everything ready to simply slap the ending in there and call the game finished.[/p][p]I've been waiting a while to do that but anyways.[/p][p]I'll just list everything I've added to the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44933927/035f46b2328c6fb4e4f94f78ecb4e89b3135cc3e.png"][/img][/p][h2]New Features[/h2][p]Angels[/p][p]Now angels will spawn on limbo after level one.[/p][p]Good luck getting to limbo though.[/p][p]Angels will take pure souls ONLY and this will kinda increase your character's purity slightly.[/p][p]You'll need multiple angels and pure souls to do this.[/p][p]The Which can get souls from you.[/p][p]The witch may appear after you get influenced by her, if she appears, she is able to get souls you're carrying, you can refuse, but she won't really like that.[/p][p]Pumpkins and Jack o' Lanterns[/p][p]I know it's not halloween but it was too easy not to add them to the game.[/p][p]You may find pumpkins as the main source of food in purgatory.[/p][p]Jack o' Lanterns are created by using a ritual candle on a pumpkin, they're really useful in decks dark.[/p][p]Brains[/p][p]Whenever you're tainted, you may get brains from looting corpses.[/p][p]Brains can be eaten when impure, crafted into gray matter salad with pepper slices or transformed into linked brains.[/p][p]Linked Brains[/p][p]Allows you to teleport to a zombie, swapping places when doing this. It makes you tainted so don't spam this a lot.[/p][p]It's crafted with a ritual candle and a brain.[/p][p]Pig Eel Fish[/p][p]Fishing with bell pepper as bait, you may get a pig eel fish that allows you to actually find smells, each smell type is assigned a random color when doing so.[/p][p]Purity Reflects on Player[/p][p]Whenever you get impure, corrupted or save/corrupt souls, your purity value changes, reflecting visually on you.[/p][p]Ritual Candles[/p][p]You may force capture a soul with a ritual candle, this massively decreases their purity.[/p][p]Flying Dragon Fish[/p][p]New balance changes, now it is actually risky to use.[/p][p]The Monster[/p][p]Rewritten smell sense almost entirely.[/p][p]Now the monster may cheat slightly more on higher difficulties.[/p][p]Also some new accessories to souls.[/p][h2]Bug Fixes! (there's a lot)[/h2][p]This time I actually wrote all of the fixes I did.[/p][p]Some baits were not listed as 'weak' baits, thus not getting fishes or squids.[/p][p]Bone Candle would not work as expected when creating a vessel[/p][p]Vessel 'barks' not being translated fixed.[/p][p]Fixed multiple bugs with the way corruption interacts with food.[/p][p]Some food checks not properly working[/p][p]Soap now actually does what intended.[/p][p]Smell of Fear rate adjusted.[/p][p]Shadows being much slower than they should be.[/p][p]Glasses now properly adjust your zoom.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44933927/8cb5cf19b5f0229af70849f5f7813e62fefd7d5f.png"][/img][/p]

tags.feature:
Angels
Now angels will spawn on limbo after level one.

Pumpkins and Jack o' Lanterns
I know it's not halloween but it was too easy not to add them to the game.

Brains
Whenever you're tainted, you may get brains from looting corpses.

Linked Brains
Allows you to teleport to a zombie, swapping places when doing this.

Pig Eel Fish
Fishing with bell pepper as bait, you may get a pig eel fish that allows you to actually find smells, each smell type is assigned a random color when doing so.

Purity Reflects on Player
Whenever you get impure, corrupted or save/corrupt souls, your purity value changes, reflecting visually on you.

Ritual Candles
You may force capture a soul with a ritual candle, this massively decreases their purity.

tags.balance_change:
Flying Dragon Fish
New balance changes, now it is actually risky to use.

tags.feature:
The Monster
Rewritten smell sense almost entirely.

tags.bug: Some baits were not listed as 'weak' baits, thus not getting fishes or squids.
Bone Candle would not work as expected when creating a vessel
Vessel 'barks' not being translated fixed.
Fixed multiple bugs with the way corruption interacts with food.
Some food checks not properly working
Soap now actually does what intended.
Shadows being much slower than they should be.
Glasses now properly adjust your zoom.

notes.title: New Demo Update! (12/8)
notes.content: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44933927/8731cdcb23360bb45b564be885ce9d0ff58c38de.png"][/img][/h1][h1]Major AI Rework[/h1][p]Now the monster has a new appearance + a lot of changes that will break the predictability it had, while not losing complexity or turning a complete chaotic beast.[/p][p]Now the monster starts as a weakling that can barely walk towards you.[/p][p]It is really weak and slow, also can't listen or even smell the player when it first spawns.[/p][p]But it evolves over time.[/p][p]It will turn into a smart unforgiving hunter that will lead to certain death if you let it get stronger.[/p][p]But as before, keeping yourself sane prevents this.[/p][p]I could go on and on about what the new AI can do, but I think playing with it will be much better than hearing about state machines.[/p][p][/p][h1]New Features[/h1][p]Fish now will spoil, turning into "chum", a new bait[/p][p]Squids can be fished from any weak bait (such as mushrooms)[/p][p]Added Calamari from frying squids.[/p][p]Added black ink from letting squids spoil.[/p][p]Added a new weird fish, caught by using chum as a bait. It is a midgame weapon that requires sustenance, that is, you can shoot it at live creatures to feed it while dealing considerable damage, but throwing it into a wall will, of course, kill it. As every weapon, you can hit yourself with it.[/p][p]A dead hunger fish may be cooked. otherwise is useless.[/p][p]Also hunger fish will surely starve if they're on your inventory for too long.[/p][p]Campfires will override your light level if their light is stronger than yours.[/p][p]Added an ink creature made by throwing black ink in the ground close to a blood puddle and activating the bone candle. It works as a "compass" to interest points, looking directly at them no matter the distance. (+ achievement related)[/p][p]Using the candle close to a corpse will decompose it. Maybe even creating mushrooms around it over time.[/p][p]Added a "goop" projectile that will be shot at wherever it's looking, this projectile is created by using your bone candle close to some ink.[/p][p]Added the vessel, created by putting a backpack close to a corpse and using a bone candle on it. The vessel works similarly to a backpack, but it takes your bad conditions from your inventory to it. you can get them back the same way you use a backpack.[/p][p]Added a brightness slider to video settings, it requires starting a new level to take effect.[/p][p]Added new corruption stages from using a bone candle too much.[/p][p]Corruption decreases sanity and has some unique interactions.[/p][p]You can cure corruption with holy water or more effectively with blessed salts. (Tainted is removed on its own and can't be cured this way)[/p][p]Added a corridor event where you will be judged based on your humanity.[/p][p]Added new influenced/manipulated cards that progress the game (for the next version they'll do some more things.) Also you may discard "influenced"[/p][p][/p][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][p]Wax is now correctly set as a bait[/p][p]Campfires will correctly spawn bonfires when one override the other.[/p][p]Fixed bug on changing environment[/p][p]Fire will now override your conditions with burns[/p][p]Fixed some item duping with the backpack and fish trap.[/p][p]Other bugs I forgot to write on my notes[/p]

tags.feature: Fish now will spoil, turning into "chum", a new bait
Squids can be fished from any weak bait (such as mushrooms)
Added Calamari from frying squids.
Added black ink from letting squids spoil.

Added a new weird fish, caught by using chum as a bait. It is a midgame weapon that requires sustenance, that is, you can shoot it at live creatures to feed it while dealing considerable damage, but throwing it into a wall will, of course, kill it. As every weapon, you can hit yourself with it.
A dead hunger fish may be cooked. otherwise is useless.
Also hunger fish will surely starve if they're on your inventory for too long.
Campfires will override your light level if their light is stronger than yours.

Added an ink creature made by throwing black ink in the ground close to a blood puddle and activating the bone candle. It works as a "compass" to interest points, looking directly at them no matter the distance. (+ achievement related)
Using the candle close to a corpse will decompose it. Maybe even creating mushrooms around it over time.
Added a "goop" projectile that will be shot at wherever it's looking, this projectile is created by using your bone candle close to some ink.

Added the vessel, created by putting a backpack close to a corpse and using a bone candle on it. The vessel works similarly to a backpack, but it takes your bad conditions from your inventory to it. you can get them back the same way you use a backpack.
Added a brightness slider to video settings, it requires starting a new level to take effect.
Added new corruption stages from using a bone candle too much.
Corruption decreases sanity and has some unique interactions.
You can cure corruption with holy water or more effectively with blessed salts. (Tainted is removed on its own and can't be cured this way)
Added a corridor event where you will be judged based on your humanity.
Added new influenced/manipulated cards that progress the game (for the next version they'll do some more things.) Also you may discard "influenced"

tags.bug: Wax is now correctly set as a bait
Campfires will correctly spawn bonfires when one override the other.
Fixed bug on changing environment
Fire will now override your conditions with burns
Fixed some item duping with the backpack and fish trap.

notes.title: The Translation Update
notes.content: [h1]TRANSLATION SUPPORT[/h1][p]Finally the game is able to be translated to multiple languages, for now, I have only added support for pt/BR, but later (with some community help) I want to add other languages. Now that the base is already working, it won't be as hard to implement others.[/p][p][/p][h2]Other things on this update[/h2][p]Added a few new materials for a new progression item.[/p][p]Wax: you can melt a candle completely using a cooking pan (select the cooking pan then the candle) to get wax[/p][p]tip: you get a cooking pan by either spending a torch + a normal pan or by using a lit campfire to instantly turn a pan into a cooking pan.[/p][p]Bone: You can get bones from corpses or skeletons. You may use 2 bones to craft bone meal.[/p][p]Using wax and bone meal together crafts a bone candle, that will be important next version.[/p][p][/p][p]Lantern fish: By using wax as a bait in the fish trap, you may trap a lantern fish, when used, reveals the position of items around you, while also emitting light.[/p][p][/p][p]Difficulty: The difficulty menu now actually lets you choose the '[i]secret difficulties[/i]'[/p][p][/p][h2]BUG FIXES[/h2][p]The survivor won't spawn anymore on purgatory.[/p][p]The survivor won't spawn after his quest is completed.[/p][p]Fixed crash on some text adventures in between corridors.[/p][p]Fixed bug where the monster would never detect smell trails.[/p][p]Fixed bug where the monster would never detect sounds.[/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: Finally the game is able to be translated to multiple languages, for now, I have only added support for pt/BR, but later (with some community help) I want to add other languages. Now that the base is already working, it won't be as hard to implement others.
Added a few new materials for a new progression item.
Wax: you can melt a candle completely using a cooking pan (select the cooking pan then the candle) to get wax
tip: you get a cooking pan by either spending a torch + a normal pan or by using a lit campfire to instantly turn a pan into a cooking pan.
Bone: You can get bones from corpses or skeletons. You may use 2 bones to craft bone meal.
Using wax and bone meal together crafts a bone candle, that will be important next version.
Lantern fish: By using wax as a bait in the fish trap, you may trap a lantern fish, when used, reveals the position of items around you, while also emitting light.
The difficulty menu now actually lets you choose the '[i]secret difficulties[/i]'

tags.bug: The survivor won't spawn anymore on purgatory.
The survivor won't spawn after his quest is completed.
Fixed crash on some text adventures in between corridors.
Fixed bug where the monster would never detect smell trails.
Fixed bug where the monster would never detect sounds.

notes.title: THE GREAT REWORK
notes.content:
[h1][b]The game got a massive rework, but don't worry, I'll guide you through everything.[/b][/h1][p]Before it was a basic generic shooting roguelite on a topdown 2D perspective... boring.[/p][p](Not that it was bad, but that wasn't what I really had in mind...)[/p][h2]The new Linear Calamity and how it works[/h2][p]Now as you can see, I basically remade the game from ground up.[/p][h3]But first some yapping about where I've been, if you care.[/h3][p]After my PC got fried up, I got really demotivated to work on the old linear calamity and eventually this lead to me abandoning the project entirely...[/p][p]Until I got back to playing some games I liked, such as darkest dungeon and something clicked after I played through some weeks and stumbled into the thing from the stars and I had an idea to go back to Linear Calamity with some new found passion.
Also, yeah, college sucks and I got burn out from it but anyways.[/p][h2]THE NEW LINEAR CALAMITY[/h2][p]Now the game works as a normal horror game, I decided to play a lot with sounds and how they would affect the game, my early prototype had some potential to a weird sound visualization...[/p][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44933927/9270a66094742f5a5a6033aa01f6e13e892587ed.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44933927/664a657a61f7f9defa0b18edecf50e555609dc77.png"][/img][/url][/p][p]As you can see, those white lines are sound.[/p][p]And they bounce around revealing the map.[/p][p]BUT WAIT THERE'S MORE[/p][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44933927/67d8a119b51ae344ab1659e884e8fba65663742a.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44933927/93af888eba470209511e0f6f1c2327d40426ead3.png"][/img][/url][/p][p]I started working with an inventory and got rid of the old shooting robot things, it wasn't really what I had in mind. Also light decreases over time, so you need to keep looking for torches if you want to keep seeing.[/p][p]Later I changed the character design and everything else.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44933927/0d9cd8ca8c67e52d2af436483cb8259b3d448afc.png"][/img]And now the game is a survival horror with all of the secrets you will suffer a lot to find! JUST LIKE THE OLD GAME![/p][p]Yeah, I still use a lot of the roguelike formula, but with a twist, instead of having those "oh I find coins and upgrade my meta character on the hub" I'm using more events that shape and unlock new things during a run, knowledge is your best weapon here.[/p][p]Keep yourself sane...[/p][p]AND BURN[/p][p]BURN THE WITCH![/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: Now the game works as a normal horror game, I decided to play a lot with sounds and how they would affect the game, my early prototype had some potential to a weird sound visualization...

I started working with an inventory and got rid of the old shooting robot things, it wasn't really what I had in mind. Also light decreases over time, so you need to keep looking for torches if you want to keep seeing.
And now the game is a survival horror with all of the secrets you will suffer a lot to find! JUST LIKE THE OLD GAME!

Yeah, I still use a lot of the roguelike formula, but with a twist, instead of having those "oh I find coins and upgrade my meta character on the hub" I'm using more events that shape and unlock new things during a run, knowledge is your best weapon here.
